title: Invoices
spec: Invoices with line items, tax, due dates, statuses draft/sent/paid, clients from CRM companies, print-to-PDF layout (@media print), numbering, CSV import/export.

title: Expenses
spec: Expense log with categories, merchants, payment method, monthly totals, bank CSV import with header mapping, people from People as spenders, report export.

title: Time tracking
spec: Start/stop timer, manual entries, projects from Tasks, weekly grid, per-person totals, CSV import/export.

title: Inventory
spec: Items with SKU, quantity, location, reorder level, low-stock filter, stock movements log, CSV import.

title: Hiring
spec: Applicant tracking: jobs, candidates, stage kanban with drag and drop, notes, source, CSV import from ATS exports.

title: Goals
spec: Objectives and key results by quarter, owners from People, progress 0–100, weighted rollup, check-ins with notes.

title: Subscriptions
spec: Vendor and subscription tracker: tool, owner, cost, billing cycle, renewal date, seats, alerts for renewals within 30 days, import from a pasted statement using NOL.detectSaaS.

title: Assets
spec: IT and equipment register: device, serial, assigned person from People, purchase date, warranty end, status, CSV import.

title: Contracts
spec: Contract templates with {{placeholders}}, fill from CRM companies and contacts, print-to-PDF, renewal and notice dates, status, reminders list.

title: Quotes
spec: Quotes and proposals from a price list, line items, discounts, totals, print-to-PDF, statuses, link to CRM deals.

title: Meetings
spec: Meeting notes: agenda, Markdown notes via NOL.md, attendees from People, decisions log, action items that create Tasks.

title: Standups
spec: Async daily check-ins: questions, per-person answers by date, history, blockers filter.

title: Retros
spec: Retrospective boards (went well / to improve / actions), votes, action items into Tasks, archive.

title: Org chart
spec: Org chart rendered as SVG from People manager field, collapse/expand, print, missing-manager report.

title: Leave calendar
spec: Month calendar of time off from People plus public holidays list, who is out today, iCal export.

title: Changelog
spec: Product updates in Markdown, tags, generate a standalone static HTML changelog file for download or GitHub Pages.

title: Status page
spec: Components with state, incidents with timeline updates, generate a standalone static status HTML for GitHub Pages.

title: Roadmap
spec: Now / Next / Later board, items linked to Tasks, export a public static roadmap HTML.

title: Help center
spec: Generate a public help center (static HTML with search) from a Wiki folder; download as a zip-free set of files or a single HTML.

title: Cash flow
spec: Recurring income and costs, one-off items, 12-month projection, runway, SVG chart.

title: Cap table
spec: Shareholders, share classes, rounds, option pool, ownership percentages, dilution calculator for a new round.

title: Onboarding
spec: Checklist templates for new hires, per-person progress from People, due dates relative to start date, owners.

title: Reviews
spec: Performance review cycles, self and manager forms, 1:1 notes, ratings, history per person.

title: Gantt
spec: Timeline view for Tasks with start/due bars, dependencies, drag to reschedule, SVG.

title: Dashboard
spec: KPI tiles from all NOL collections (pipeline, open tickets, headcount, overdue tasks) plus manual metrics with sparklines.

title: Feedback
spec: Customer feedback board: ideas, votes recorded by team, status, link to Tasks, CSV import.

title: Purchase orders
spec: POs to vendors (CRM companies), line items, approval status, received quantities, print-to-PDF.

title: Budgets
spec: Budgets vs actuals per team and category, monthly grid, variance highlighting, CSV import of actuals.

title: Rooms
spec: Meeting room and desk booking: resources, day view, bookings by people, conflicts prevented.

title: Mind maps
spec: Mind map editor: nodes, drag, keyboard add/indent, SVG export.

title: Whiteboard
spec: Infinite canvas with sticky notes, arrows, text, pan/zoom, SVG export.

title: Training
spec: Internal courses from Wiki pages, lessons order, completion tracking per person, quiz questions.

title: CRM reports
spec: Pipeline by stage and owner, win rate, monthly closed-won, SVG charts, CSV export.

title: Desk macros and SLA
spec: Canned replies with variables, SLA targets per priority, breach highlighting.

title: Recurring tasks
spec: Recurrence rules (daily/weekly/monthly), auto-create next occurrence on done, checklists inside tasks.

title: vCard import
spec: Import .vcf (Google Contacts, Outlook, iCloud) into contacts; duplicate detection by email with merge.
